title: Pen patterns
summary: Draw a square, then turn it into a flower with a loop inside a loop.

steps.text: From Events, drag “when game starts” into the workspace.
Draw a square: repeat 4 times, move 100 steps and turn right 90 degrees. Put it inside “when game starts”.
Run it to see your square.
Make a flower: put your square inside another “repeat”, and turn 30 degrees after each square. Repeat 12 times.
Choose a pen color inside the outer repeat.
Run it again and admire your pattern.

finish.text: You drew a pattern with a loop inside a loop!
remix: Draw stars instead of squares: turn 144 degrees, 5 times.
Change the color on every turn of the outer loop.
